'''Syychi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Albino/Legends|albino]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. She stood nearly 2.4 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, and was generally a silent individual when her temper was not aroused. Born a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] world of [[Vizcarra]], she never saw the Wookiee home planet, [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], a fact which bedeviled her.

At one point, Syychi shared a cell on a prison ship bound for Vizcarra with the young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Memcha-Badawzi]], daughter of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Abdi-Badawzi]]. The Twi'lek woman inspired Syychi, and the pair led a prisoner revolt that overtook the ship's crew and allowed all aboard to escape. After obtaining their freedom, Syychi followed Memcha to Neftali, where she became second-in-command of [[Cordel Cove]] under Memcha. She was frequently in charge of a contingent of the planet's [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] security staff, whom she would call on without hesitation should she be provoked by troublemakers.

"Syychi" is [[Olys Corellisi/Legends|Old Corellian]] for "quiet."
